hypotheses.reasoning: accounts-db data volume filled (95% -> 99% with WAL growth ~430-463MB/h), then writes fail with 'No space left on device'; account-svc inserts into accounts fail, propagating as 500s on POST /login at edge-proxy. Reads unaffected, matching alert. No deploy found; audit_log slow query is an unrelated red herring.
Unbounded WAL growth could stem from a misconfigured retention/replication slot or archiving, but no direct evidence.

verdict.recommendedAction: Free disk on accounts-db immediately (expand volume, purge old WAL/logs), investigate the WAL growth source (stuck replication slot / failed archiving), add disk-usage alerting before 95%; verify account inserts and /login recover.
